body.title: Investigation report — P0007
body.summary: 3 finding(s) across 1 entities. Lead finding: Associated with operation OP-P0003. ₹48,379 at risk, ₹968 assessed as still recoverable. 0 recommendation(s) for review.

findings.title: Associated with operation OP-P0003
findings.detail: Money-mule network: 5 entities joined by 6 funds link(s). Cohesion 60%, confidence 30%, exposure ₹1,314,640. Linked to 4 other entities: P0003, P0005, P0010, P0016

findings.title: Linked to P0010 by funds
findings.detail: 10 transfers totalling 523,000 across 10 days — a standing payment relationship, weak evidence of a ring

loss_prevented.basis: Per-event estimate: each debit is placed in a recovery band by how long ago it settled, and the band's assumed recovery share is applied. Funds already withdrawn as cash are counted as unrecoverable.
assumptions: Assumes a freeze request is actioned promptly by the receiving bank.
An estimate for prioritisation, not a forecast of actual recovery.

caveats: Every finding here is a lead for human review. Nothing in this report is a determination of guilt.
Risk scores rank the review queue; they are not evidence and are not presented as such.
No finding reached 'confirmed'. The case rests on probable and possible inferences, and should be treated accordingly.
The recoverable figure is an estimate from stated assumptions, not a commitment that those funds will be returned.
